walks.walk_a: arm-anchored: one lifecycle per armed regime, reference price and ATR frozen at the Top-10 arm; deeper levels subset the population and never move the origin
walks.walk_b: per-level independent: one hypothetical entry per level reached, own reference price, own frozen ATR, own 1.0 ATR stop

session_rule: RTH only, forced flat 15:00 CT, level reach must fall inside the arm's own session
threshold_overlap_disclosure: both calibration populations are calendar-2025 and overlap the evaluation window; 2025 is not threshold-OOS
